{{No footnotes|date=August 2012}}
'''''Institut de Mathématiques de Toulouse''''' (Toulouse Mathematics Institute; IMT) is a research laboratory of the [[mathematics]] community of the [[Toulouse]] area in France. It is partially supported by the French public research agency [[CNRS]] as unit [[Unité mixte de recherche|UMR]] 5129. In 2020 the research in IMT is organized into six main teams, with some overlap:

*[https://www.math.univ-toulouse.fr/spip.php?article1023 Analyse] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210418200454/https://www.math.univ-toulouse.fr/spip.php?article1023 |date=2021-04-18 }}, 
*[https://www.math.univ-toulouse.fr/spip.php?article1024 Dynamique et géométrie complexe] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210418205455/https://www.math.univ-toulouse.fr/spip.php?article1024 |date=2021-04-18 }}, 
*[https://www.math.univ-toulouse.fr/spip.php?article1025 Équations aux dérivées partielles] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210418170608/https://www.math.univ-toulouse.fr/spip.php?article1025 |date=2021-04-18 }},
*[https://www.math.univ-toulouse.fr/spip.php?article1026 Géométrie topologie algèbre] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210418182835/https://www.math.univ-toulouse.fr/spip.php?article1026 |date=2021-04-18 }},
*[https://www.math.univ-toulouse.fr/spip.php?article1027 Probabilités] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210418193227/https://www.math.univ-toulouse.fr/spip.php?article1027 |date=2021-04-18 }},
*[https://www.math.univ-toulouse.fr/spip.php?article1028 Statistiques et optimisation] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210418181238/https://www.math.univ-toulouse.fr/spip.php?article1028 |date=2021-04-18 }}.  

IMT is one of the largest French research centres in mathematics, and its scientific activities cover almost all domains of mathematics. It had approximately 200 permanent [[researcher]]s and 100 [[PhD student]]s in 2020, belonging to various institutions of the [[University of Toulouse]] and CNRS.

The main buildings of IMT are located on the [[Paul Sabatier University]] campus.

IMT is in charge of the [[Fermat Prize]] and of the publication ''[[Annales de la Faculté des Sciences de Toulouse]]''.
